verdict.rationale: Bruno stores collections as plain-text Bru files in filesystem folders, and the Scripts tab exists at request, folder, and collection level, which shows a collection/folder hierarchy. Saved collections can be rerun at any time with the Bruno CLI, locally, in Docker, or in CI pipelines, and community users confirm collections persist as committed text files. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of creating and nesting folders (only implied via folder-level scripts), and evidence of an in-app GUI collection/folder runner.
